commits.message:
docs: fix HTML config transform example to set advancedCustomization under debug

The example set advancedCustomization at the root of config.json, a path the UI
does not read. Move it under debug, restructure the page into two examples,
and document that the source path resolves relative to the layer's
cmfpackage.json, that multiple Transform entries are concatenated, and that
the generated file always carries customizationVersion.

Closes #882
